title: Weather.gov API - Business Requirements Document
description: Comprehensive BRD for weather.gov API covering all endpoints for weather data retrieval, alerts, forecasts, and observations

requirements.title: Get Active Alerts for Zone
requirements.description: Retrieve active weather alerts for a specific zone
acceptance_criteria: API returns active alerts for valid zone IDs
API returns appropriate error for invalid zone IDs
Response includes alert severity and description

requirements.title: Get Forecast for Grid Point
requirements.description: Retrieve weather forecast for a specific grid point
acceptance_criteria: API returns forecast data for valid grid points
Forecast includes temperature, precipitation, and conditions

requirements.title: Get Latest Observation
requirements.description: Retrieve the latest weather observation from a station
acceptance_criteria: API returns latest observation for valid station IDs
Observation includes temperature, humidity, and wind data
